record.context_brief: Variety generated by primitive skew lattices
record.original_question: Describe the subvariety of skew lattices generated by all primitive skew lattices. The source states that this subvariety must be distributive, hence categorical, cancellative, hence symmetric, and strictly categorical; determine what additional properties it has and give necessary and sufficient conditions for a skew lattice to belong to it.

evidence.quote: What can be said about the subvariety of skew lattices generated from all primitive skew lattices?
It must be: distributive (and thus categorical), cancellative (and thus symmetric) and strictly categorical.
Again, what are necessary and sufficient conditions for a skew lattice to be in this subvariety?

artifact.status_search_result: The problem of describing the subvariety of skew lattices generated by all primitive skew lattices, and characterizing membership in it, appears as an open question in the NCS 2018 open problems list and related recent work on distributive and coset-structured skew lattices. No subsequent paper located in the search provides a complete characterization, so the problem appears to remain open.
